# ArqUX

> Governance infrastructure for AI-agent teams: workspaces, sessions, cycles, blueprints, evidence, and memory — 115 MCP handlers over stdio.

Primary human docs are Spanish (`docs/es/`); `docs/en/` is the complete 1:1 English mirror (same paths, English body), and `docs/en/root/` holds the English twins of the root documents. This index is curated by agent task, not by topic.

## Install & first run

- [README](README.md) — [Platform] use when: you need the 30-second product door, badges, and install note (`pip install arqux` currently serves 0.9.0).
- [Quick start ES](docs/es/tutorial/inicio-rapido.md) — [Tutorial] use when: you want a governed workspace end-to-end (~10 min, verified commands).
- [Getting started EN](docs/en/tutorial/inicio-rapido.md) — [Tutorial] use when: English quick start preferred.
- [CLI reference](docs/es/referencia/cli.md) — [Reference] use when: checking whether an `arqux <cmd>` exists and its flags.
- [Configuration](docs/es/referencia/configuracion.md) — [Reference] use when: setting env vars, `ARQUX_AGENT_ID`, `.arqux/` layout.
- [Deployment](docs/es/guias/despliegue.md) — [Guide] use when: deploying ArqUX — modes, env vars, hardening, shared journal, measured perf.

## Connect via MCP

- [Agent boot](docs/es/guias/arranque-agente.md) — [Guide] use when: starting an agent session — `arqux wake`, identity, tier, bootstrap.
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md) — [Explanation] use when: you need the real 1.0.0 layout — 18 handler modules, layers, codec boundary.
- [Handlers reference](HANDLERS.md) — [Reference] use when: looking up a handler's params/types (generated from REGISTRY).

## Operate governance

- [Project to agents](docs/es/guias/proyectar-agentes.md) — [Guide] use when: generating `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`/`GEMINI.md` via `sync-harnesses` and detecting drift.
- [Sync a team](docs/es/guias/sincronizar-equipo.md) — [Guide] use when: pushing/pulling policies between teammates.
- [Permissions](PERMISSIONS.md) — [Reference] use when: checking which role can call which handler (115-row generated table, HMAC flags).

## Audit & verify

- [Audit work](docs/es/guias/auditar-trabajo.md) — [Guide] use when: running `arqux review` and tamper-detection flows.
- [Evidence & compliance](docs/es/guias/evidencia-y-cumplimiento.md) — [Guide] use when: preparing a CISO/compliance evidence package.
- [Evidence catalog](EVIDENCE.md) — [Reference] use when: checking which evidence artifacts exist and how each is verified.
- [Threat model](THREAT_MODEL.md) — [Reference] use when: mapping a security control to its mechanism and executable verification.
- [Journal & order](docs/es/explicacion/journal-y-orden.md) — [Explanation] use when: understanding why the journal exists and how ordering works.
- [Test suite](docs/es/explicacion/test-suite-framework.md) — [Explanation] use when: understanding the evidence-derived test suite.

## Understand the design

- [Codec boundary](docs/es/explicacion/frontera-codec.md) — [Explanation] use when: separating what ArqUX owns vs `codec-cortex` 1.0.x.
- [Edge cases](docs/es/explicacion/casos-limite.md) — [Explanation] use when: concurrent access, empty brain, invalid cortex, missing handler/identity.
- [CORTEX canon](docs/es/especificacion/README.md) — [Canon] use when: reading the normative `.cortex` format spec — 17 docs indexed at corpus level via this README.
- [Failure catalog](docs/es/referencia/errores.md) — [Reference] use when: mapping an `ERR_*`/`POLICY_*` code to its meaning.
- [Product formats](docs/es/referencia/formatos.md) — [Reference] use when: parsing artifact formats (evidence, brain, manifests).

- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) — [Guide] use when: setting up a dev env and submitting a change.
